chunks: So do not invent similitudes for God. Indeed God knows, and you do not know.
ai.seo_question: What does it mean to 'strike similitudes' for God in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia tafsir, this verse is central to the doctrine of divine transcendence (tanzih), warning against anthropomorphism (tashbih) by noting that human similitudes are inherently limited. It underscores that while God knows all realities, human understanding is constrained by finite experience, necessitating humility in theological attribution.
